title: 63% of developers have more work since non-devs began coding with AI, but most say it's good for the industry
summary: 66% of developers think it's a positive thing for the industry when people without tech experience code with AI—it lets the devs do more complex work.
body_markdown: As dev work changes, your tech stack may get as tangled as the mess of wires behind your desk.[Zapier](https://zapier.com/) lets you create end-to-end systems across every app you use, no matter where you build—including directly from your codebase with[Zapier SDK](https://zapier.com/sdk) . Plus, built-in AI guardrails and OAuth-managed authentication allow you to build the workflows you need without worrying about a rogue agent spinning out of control.
